tools.name: get_app_info
tools.description: Return canonical origin, protocol endpoint, schemas and public capabilities.

tools.name: list_maps
tools.description: List exact map IDs, world bounds and published region IDs before creating content.

tools.name: list_map_categories
tools.description: List published topic/category names and depth on a map for add_map_content.

tools.name: get_agent_guidance
tools.description: Return the authoritative coordinate, contribution and publication rules.

tools.name: search_topics
tools.description: Search published topic titles and summaries. Responses are bounded to 100.

tools.name: alkemata-get-site-info
tools.description: Get the published WordPress site's identity, URLs and language.

tools.name: alkemata-search-published-content
tools.description: Search published WordPress posts or pages through the existing public MCP.

tools.name: alkemata-get-published-content
tools.description: Read a published WordPress post or page through the existing public MCP.

tools.name: alkemata-get-agent-guidance
tools.description: Get WordPress's published-site guidance and authoritative URLs.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search published articles on alkemata.com by keyword; returns titles, summaries and URLs.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read the full text and canonical URL of a published article on alkemata.com.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Return complete permitted blocks, published sources and relationships for one topic.

tools.name: get_region
tools.description: Return published objects for a viewport; obtain map_id from list_maps first.

tools.name: get_trail
tools.description: Return a published learning trail with steps and branches.

tools.name: create_topic_at_position
tools.description: Create a topic and placement; copy map_id from list_maps, and omit region_id unless needed.

tools.name: add_map_content
tools.description: Add a topic near its named parent category; omit category_name for a top-level topic.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "alkemata-public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: alkemata-get-site-info, alkemata-search-published-content, alkemata-get-published-content, alkemata-get-agent-guidance, search_articles, get_article · Public sink: alkemata-get-published-content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: alkemata-get-site-info, alkemata-search-published-content, alkemata-get-published-content, alkemata-get-agent-guidance, search_articles, get_article · Public sink: alkemata-get-published-content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
